label: TodoWorkspace
prompt: Use concise daily task rows with prominent titles, assignees, due dates, and completion states. Make overdue work noticeable with text and subtle emphasis; keep quick entry and attributed comments convenient beside the current task. Keep daisyUI theme and shared shell defaults, canonical permissions/actions, localized labels, complete forms/errors, visible keyboard focus, and responsive stacking. Apply consistently to each styled page content scope; keep page admission and the shared shell unchanged.
